items.citation_text: North York General appoints Simone Atungo and Dr. Kathryn Nichol; NYG recruitment notice for two new Governors
items.verbatim_snippet: Simone Atungo, founder and CEO of Onuera Consulting, and Dr. Kathryn Nichol, President and CEO of VHA Home HealthCare, were appointed to North York General’s Board of Governors.

items.citation_text: North York General announces new Board members
items.verbatim_snippet: At the June 16, 2025 Annual General Meeting, Paviter Binning, Deputy Chairman and a director of Wittington Investments, was elected to the North York General hospital Board of Governors.

items.role: Vice President, Clinical Services and Chief Nursing Executive
items.citation_text: Terri Stuart-McEwan appointed VP, Clinical Services and Chief Nursing Executive
items.verbatim_snippet: Terri Stuart-McEwan was selected as Vice President, Clinical Services and Chief Nursing Executive, with a start date of February 11, 2025.

items.role: Vice President, Finance, Data Analytics and Chief Financial Officer
items.citation_text: Paul Truscott appointed VP, Finance, Data Analytics and CFO
items.verbatim_snippet: Paul Truscott Jr. joined NYGH as Vice President, Finance, Data Analytics and Chief Financial Officer.

items.citation_text: Paul Truscott appointed VP, Finance, Data Analytics and CFO
items.verbatim_snippet: NYGH also recognized Peter Wegener’s financial stewardship as Interim CFO and his support during the transition.

items.role: Vice President, Quality, Post-Acute Care and Community Integration
items.citation_text: Jennifer Dockery appointed inaugural VP, Quality, Post-Acute Care and Community Integration
items.verbatim_snippet: Jennifer Dockery was appointed to a newly created vice-president portfolio covering community health and integrated care, clinical and operational planning for the new long-term-care development and seniors’ health hub, ambulatory programs, the Reactivation Care Centre, and oversight of Quality, Risk and Ethics.

items.role: Chief of Medicine and Program Medical Director
items.citation_text: NYGH March 2023 leadership update
items.verbatim_snippet: NYGH identified Dr. Maral Nadjafi as its new Chief of Medicine and Program Medical Director. She had served as Interim Chief since November 2021 and had participated in the hospital’s COVID-19 response before assuming the permanent role.

items.citation_text: Karyn Popovich announces retirement; NYGH Board Chair’s CEO announcement
items.verbatim_snippet: Karyn Popovich informed the Board of Governors that she would retire after a career of more than 40 years at NYGH.
